collection.description: A child refuses to join a group activity that every adult expects them to enjoy.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) refuses to join a group activity that every adult expects them to enjoy.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) reveals they dislike the noise, not the other children.

text_only.reason: a feeling in the moment, not a lasting dislike -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) simply prefers a quiet afternoon and appreciates being heard.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) helps prepare materials instead of performing.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The alternative feels like another obligation, so the adults reconsider.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child) agrees to the safety briefing but skips the optional game.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (adult) realizes they had confused tradition with requirement.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) joins later of their own accord.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) never joins and has a perfectly pleasant day anyway.
